summary: Fortis Inc. furnished a 6-K attaching a September 9, 2026 press release pricing a US$1.0 billion public offering of two series of fixed-to-fixed rate junior subordinated notes due March 30, 2057: US$500 million at 6.625% and US$500 million at 6.875%. Underwriters are co-led by Morgan Stanley, MUFG, Wells Fargo and BofA, with a broader syndicate. Closing is expected September 21, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Net proceeds will repay maturing indebtedness and fund general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for the prospectus supplement and any ratings or leverage commentary.
